records.text: Could you help me with this?
I will be home in ten minutes.
Where did you put the keys?
Let us talk about it later.
Set a timer for five minutes.
What is next on the list?
Please go to the next page.
I will see you next week.
This is a nice mix of songs.
We need six cups of water.
Hey Nick, can you help me?
Hey Nick, what time is it?
Nick, please turn on the light.

policy: All stereo directory assets in sound-theme-freedesktop 0.8-2. Resolve file aliases once. Average channels and polyphase-resample full sources to 16 kHz. Add the external alert at half digital gain 200 ms before the fixed shared command clock. One original-level paired dry command. One different development utterance per asset in corpus order. Silent electrical reference and a fresh continuously primed detector per input. Natural elapsed time and risk in real households require device observations.
